title: ENG-205 Beowulf Part 2 — 2 Names
subject: ENG-205
topic: Beowulf Part 2 (Another Attack to Another Celebration at Heorot)

cards.def: Grendel's mother is a monstrous water-hag of Cain's line who lives in the mere and comes to Heorot "desperate for revenge" for her son.
Aeschere, Yrmenlaf's elder brother, was Hrothgar's "right-hand man," "true mentor," and most trusted counselor, whom Grendel's mother carried off and killed (around line 1323).
Unferth, "the brehon" and son of Ecglaf, lends Beowulf Hrunting but, "not man enough" to fight underwater, "lost fame and repute" (around line 1471).

cards.term: The two monsters of the moors
cards.def: Hrothgar's counselors had seen two creatures on the moors, one that "looks like a woman" and one "warped in the shape of a man" called Grendel, both "fatherless" with an ancestry hidden among demons (around line 1351).
